sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS payment_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS refund_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END) AS gross_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS discount_cents
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 统计范围为青禾客户在 2026 年 8 月（按下单日期归属）的已支付订单，未做额外分组。结果：实付金额 1190.50 元；退款金额 187.50 元；净销售额 1003.00 元；支付订单原价金额 1242.50 元；优惠金额 52.00 元。口径上，实付金额尚未扣退款，净销售额为实付减退款，退款按原订单下单日期归属而非现金退款发生日，取消单不计入净销售额，退款也不冲减原优惠金额。
